notes: Access: direct HTTP fetch, no WAF/block encountered (matches prior-pass notes). Checked: main mega-nav (no dedicated Bestsellers nav section - nav is Sofas&chairs/Beds&headboards/room categories/rugs&soft-furnishings/Outlet only), sitemap.xml (found 4 distinct bestseller-type PLPs under /edits/, none linked from main nav/header/footer, only discoverable via sitemap), and on-site search (/search?q=bestseller, best%20sellers, favourites - search results page only echoes the full standard nav, no additional bestseller-specific URLs beyond what sitemap already surfaced). All 4 candidates opened and confirmed as real product-grid PLPs (listing-item__card blocks, D3R 'listing'/'edit' component with data-data totalResults JSON matching the rendered 'Showing X of Y' pagination text) - not editorial pages. /edits/best-sellers (h1 'Loaf's most-loved', title 'Spring Best Sellers') and /edits/loaf-favourites (h1/title 'Loaf favourites') both report qty=25 but were verified to be genuinely different product sets (compared /products/ hrefs on each page - zero overlap of the sampled cards), so both kept as separate rows per the brief's non-dedup-by-count rule. /edits/sale-bestsellers (title 'Sale bestsellers', h1 'Bestsellers') lists the bestselling items currently within the sale/outlet-adjacent selection - kept as a genuine Bestsellers-labelled listing (site's own h1 calls it Bestsellers) distinct in product count (43) from the other three. /edits/best-sellers-in-house-fabrics (h1 'Best Sellers in House Fabrics') is a real sofa/chair product grid (e.g. Smithy Sofa) representing bestsellers within Loaf's in-house fabric range, qty=21. No genuine site-defined parent/child nesting exists among these four (no single 'Bestsellers' hub page links to all of them) so all four are emitted as flat sibling rows under category Bestsellers. No is_group rows.
